lines.zh: 我贴着海面跑，尾摆得飞快。
lines.en: I race beneath the surface, tail beating fast.

lines.zh: 我们五条并排，像一支箭。
lines.en: Five abreast, we are one arrow.

lines.zh: 近海的浪推我，我顺着冲。
lines.en: The inshore swell pushes; I ride it.

lines.zh: 我三十厘米，转身只要半格。
lines.en: Thirty centimetres, and I turn in half a block.

lines.zh: 我的背是蓝的，肚子是银的。
lines.en: Blue above, silver below.
We turn, all at once, as a school.

lines.zh: 我游得比这里的水流快。
lines.en: I swim faster than this current.

lines.zh: 出了海湾，就是开阔的洋。
lines.en: Past the bay lies the open sea.

lines.zh: 我追着一条更小的鱼跑。
lines.en: I chase a fish smaller than me.
Water rushes past my gills.

lines.zh: 我加速，超过了前面那条。
lines.en: I speed up and pass the leader.
We travel in the same layer of water.
I cut through the school like rain.

lines.zh: 六十五厘米的前辈在前面。
lines.en: A sixty-five-centimetre elder leads.

lines.zh: 我们贴着礁石边缘绕过去。
lines.en: We slip around the reef's edge.

lines.zh: 前面的水变冷了，我们上浮。
lines.en: Colder water ahead; we rise.

lines.zh: 我摆三下尾，就超过了同伴。
lines.en: Three tail beats and I lead.

lines.zh: 浪打在礁上，我们退开一点。
lines.en: Waves hit the rock; we drift back.

lines.zh: 银色的肚子翻过来，又正回去。
lines.en: My silver belly rolls and rights itself.

lines.zh: 我拐进海湾，队伍跟着拐。
lines.en: I turn into the bay and the school follows.
I stop, tail still ticking.

lines.zh: 海面在头顶碎成小块的光。
lines.en: The surface breaks into patches of light.

lines.zh: 我们悬在同一深度，不动。
lines.en: We hang at one depth, unmoving.

lines.zh: 咸味在我嘴里，一直是咸的。
lines.en: Salt in my mouth, always salt.

lines.zh: 远处有海鸟的影子掠过。
lines.en: A seabird's shadow sweeps past.
I turn side-on and let the water pass.

lines.zh: 我的鳃一张一合，很规律。
lines.en: My gills work in steady rhythm.
This quiet makes me uneasy.

lines.zh: 一条同伴蹭了蹭我的侧线。
lines.en: A schoolmate brushes my lateral line.

lines.zh: 我等潮水掉头，好跟着走。
lines.en: I wait for the tide to turn so I can follow.

lines.zh: 我的速度是攒着的，不用。
lines.en: My speed is stored, unused.
The surface is far up. I stay down.

lines.zh: 洋流从东边过来，带着凉。
lines.en: The current comes from the east, cold.

lines.zh: 我数着同伴的尾巴，五条。
lines.en: I count tails: five of us.
You are on a boat; the wood smells strong.
Your rod tip draws circles on the water.
Through the swell you wobble.

lines.zh: 你手里的线细得看不见。
lines.en: The line in your hand is nearly invisible.
You wait. We all wait.

lines.zh: 你撒下的东西在水面散开。
lines.en: What you scatter spreads on the surface.
I glance up at you, then look away.

lines.zh: 你的影子在水下拉得很长。
lines.en: Your shadow stretches out long underwater.

lines.zh: 你数我们，我们也在数你。
lines.en: You count us; we count you.
There is water sloshing in your bucket.
The scales along my flank are scraped away.
Blood trails in the water.
I bolt in pain and hit a schoolmate.
My lateral line is ringing.
I roll a full turn before steadying.
The whole school scatters with me.
I swim slower than before.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我的鳃盖上。
lines.en: That lands on my gill cover.
I dare not stop. Stopping is the end.
Still alive. Still swimming.

lines.zh: 那块亮亮的东西在往下沉。
lines.en: That bright thing is sinking.
One snap and I have it.
I circle once; it is still there.
A schoolmate dashes first; I follow.
I try a bite; it will not give.
A line runs from it.

lines.zh: 我往旁边窜，线拉住了我。
lines.en: I bolt sideways; the line holds.
I pull. The drag is not much.
The surface comes closer.

lines.zh: 我还在游，只是方向变了。
lines.en: I still swim, only the direction changed.
Who hit me? My whole body is askew.
One move from you and the school breaks.

lines.zh: 我这么轻，被推出去两格。
lines.en: Light as I am, I am shoved two blocks.
A hull scrapes my back.

lines.zh: 我撞上同伴，鳞片响了一声。
lines.en: I hit a schoolmate; scales click.
The water churns into white foam.
I spin once and find my heading.
You are blocking the current.
The five of us bunch up.
I slip past your hand.
Not much force, but frightening.
I fall back into the school.
Your stripes are as dark as mine.

lines.zh: 我们并排，谁也慢不下来。
lines.en: Side by side, neither of us slows.
You are half a length longer.
Stay on me. Do not drop out.
We circle once, then go.

lines.zh: 洋流会把我们送到一起。
lines.en: The current will bring us together.

lines.zh: 你尾摆的频率和我一样。
lines.en: Your tail beats at my tempo.
Of the five, you swim best.
Do not bump me. Just swim beside me.
Let us run this shoal together.

lines.zh: 一小块东西漂过，我接住。
lines.en: A small piece drifts by; I catch it.
I swallow while swimming, never stopping.
Too hard. I spit it out.
Not enough. I keep hunting.
I bite it before my schoolmate.
The current takes it. Gone.
I gulp it nearly without chewing.

lines.zh: 咸的东西，我尝不出别的。
lines.en: Salt. I taste nothing else.
I flick the crumbs to those behind.
One bite and I am fast again.
A big shadow enters the school.
Something from the surface comes down.
Every schoolmate flashes to one side.
That is no current. It is alive.

lines.zh: 它的影子比五条我们还宽。
lines.en: Its shadow is wider than five of us.
The water suddenly feels heavy.
I hear a line slicing water.
The school scatters; I am still here.
It comes for the silver flash.

lines.zh: 我抢在大伙前面窜出去。
lines.en: I bolt before the rest of the school.
I stare, my tail wound tight.
Each time it moves, I change angle.
I am picking the shortest escape.
My heartbeat matches my tail.
None of the school dares move first.
I press against a schoolmate's flank.
If it dives, I shoot upward.
My silver belly gives me away.
The pressure shifts. It is closer.
I wait for a gap.
I ram it once and run.
I bite down on its finger.
Two hearts. I cannot afford to stop.
I whip its wrist with my tail.
The blow lands light as rain.
I bite and dive back into the school.
Fine teeth, one small cut.
One sweep of its hand and we scatter.
I go for its eye and miss.
The impact leaves me dizzy.

lines.zh: 我在这片开阔海里出现。
lines.en: I appear in open water.
The surface is forty blocks up.

lines.zh: 五条同伴和我一起睁眼。
lines.en: Five schoolmates open their eyes with me.
The water is salt and cold.
The inshore shallows are busy.

lines.zh: 我一出生就在队伍中间。
lines.en: I am born in the middle of the line.
My stripes are not yet dark.
The current shoves me a block out.
Light moves on the surface.
I beat my tail and join the school.

lines.zh: 水面烫得像铁板，我往下钻。
lines.en: The surface is hot iron; I dive.

lines.zh: 我被甩到半空，落回水里。
lines.en: Flung into the air, I fall back in.

lines.zh: 我在甲板上拍尾，鳃贴着木头。
lines.en: On the deck I slap my tail against wood.

lines.zh: 水炸开，我被推出去三格。
lines.en: The water bursts and throws me three blocks.

lines.zh: 箭从水面下来，穿过我的背。
lines.en: An arrow comes down through my back.

lines.zh: 一股凉意锁住了我的尾。
lines.en: A cold grip locks my tail.
Hunger drops me out of formation.

lines.zh: 雷劈海面，我整条都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sea and lights me through.
The sea ends. I fall into nothing.
